verdict.rationale: The Drive API documents a permissions resource that grants users, groups, domains, or anyone access to files, folders, and shared drives with roles such as organizer and writer. That allows scripted access and membership control on shared drives, plus sharing-info audits. There is no evidence of user provisioning, group creation or membership management, or admin-console endpoints; missing for 10: member provisioning API, group management endpoints, documented admin/directory API for automation, independent corroboration.
